summary.text: Dan Johnson is the Republican candidate for the Hawaii House of Representatives, District 12, where he faces Democratic incumbent Kyle Yamashita in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A project manager born and raised on Maui, he ran for the same seat in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Johnson was born in Wailuku, Hawaii, and earned an associate degree from the University of Hawaii, Maui, in 2011 and a bachelor's degree from the University of Hawaii at Manoa in 2014, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey he said he has four generations of family on Maui, holds a finance degree, and has worked in project management for about a decade, including as a construction project manager.
Johnson lost the 2022 general election for District 12 to incumbent Kyle Yamashita, receiving 20.5% of the vote, and lost again in 2024 with 27.0%.

In his 2026 survey, he said his priorities include reducing the cost of living through state tax adjustments and local homeownership incentives, reducing permitting bureaucracy and property taxes for owner-occupants, and a voucher system in which school funding follows the student.
He also called for rules to prevent conflicts of interest in watershed management and for state action on the Upcountry Maui water supply.
